title: Geometry Ingestion Preflight — Provenance, Temporal Attachment & Candidate-Status Quarantine (CTO Revision)
authority: Independent CTO / Co-founder Directive W016-C3 Correction Round

relational_integrity_architecture.rejection_of_polymorphic_fk: The generic entity_type + entity_id + version_id polymorphic design is completely removed. PostgreSQL cannot enforce FK integrity across different target tables with polymorphic columns.

alternative_1_typed_nullable_fks_with_ex.description: Single relation public.entity_geometries containing explicit typed FK columns for each hierarchy level, bounded by CHECK (num_nonnulls(...) = 1) and type-alignment checks.
pros: Preserves a single unified spatial relation for cross-hierarchy spatial analysis and spatial indexing
Every target is an authentic PostgreSQL FOREIGN KEY constraint with ON DELETE RESTRICT
Simplifies centralized RLS policies and spatial triggers

alternative_2_separate_typed_geometry_re.description: Separate tables: constituency_geometries, district_geometries, mandal_geometries, each with a NOT NULL FK.
cons: Requires duplicating RLS policies, spatial triggers, and catalog schemas across 4+ tables
Complicates cross-boundary spatial predicates (e.g. AC overlaps District)

selected_fk_chain.mandal: entity_geometries.mandal_id -> public.mandals(id) (anchored to MoPR statutory directory)

columns.name: constituency_version_id
columns.type: UUID REFERENCES public.constituency_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: district_version_id
columns.type: UUID REFERENCES public.district_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: state_version_id
columns.type: UUID REFERENCES public.state_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: mandal_id
columns.type: TEXT REFERENCES public.mandals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: dataset_version_id
columns.type: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.dataset_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: provenance_id
columns.type: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.provenance_records(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

check_constraints.name: chk_entity_geometries_type_alignment
check_constraints.definition: CHECK ((entity_type = 'assembly_constituency' AND constituency_version_id IS NOT NULL) OR (entity_type = 'district' AND district_version_id IS NOT NULL) OR (entity_type = 'state' AND state_version_id IS NOT NULL) OR (entity_type = 'parliamentary_constituency' AND pc_version_id IS NOT NULL) OR (entity_type = 'mandal' AND mandal_id IS NOT NULL))

check_constraints.name: chk_geometry_current_invariants
check_constraints.definition: CHECK ((is_current = false) OR (is_current = true AND status = 'OFFICIAL' AND temporal_classification = 'CURRENT_LEGAL' AND authority_classification IN ('OFFICIAL_CONSTITUTIONAL_GEOMETRY', 'OFFICIAL_STATUTORY_GEOMETRY') AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > CURRENT_DATE)))

check_constraints.name: chk_geometry_status_classification_consistency
check_constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = 'OFFICIAL' AND authority_classification IN ('OFFICIAL_CONSTITUTIONAL_GEOMETRY', 'OFFICIAL_STATUTORY_GEOMETRY') AND temporal_classification IN ('CURRENT_LEGAL', 'HISTORICAL_LEGAL')) OR (status = 'UNVERIFIED' AND authority_classification IN ('UNVERIFIED_STATE_GIS_CANDIDATE', 'UNVERIFIED_FIXTURE_GEOMETRY')) OR (status = 'SCENARIO' AND authority_classification = 'SCENARIO_PROJECTION_GEOMETRY' AND temporal_classification = 'SCENARIO'))

check_constraints.name: chk_mandal_historical_only
check_constraints.definition: CHECK (entity_type != 'mandal' OR (authority_classification = 'UNVERIFIED_STATE_GIS_CANDIDATE' AND temporal_classification = 'HISTORICAL_LEGAL' AND is_current = false AND valid_to = '2022-09-01'))

database_quarantine_and_rls.architecture: Quarantine enforced directly at base table public.entity_geometries via Row Level Security (RLS). Public users cannot bypass quarantine via direct SELECT.

public_policy.policy_name: Public read official current geometries only
public_policy.using: status = 'OFFICIAL' AND is_current = true AND temporal_classification = 'CURRENT_LEGAL'
public_policy.quarantine_guarantee: UNVERIFIED candidates, SCENARIOS, and HISTORICAL geometries are completely INVISIBLE to public users.

service_role_policy.policy_name: Service role full access on entity_geometries

database_quarantine_and_rls.w010_compatibility: Fully conforms to Kshetra W010 security architecture; no custom roles or parallel mechanisms introduced.

enforcement_layers.foreign_key: dataset_version_id references public.dataset_versions(id); provenance_id references public.provenance_records(id).
enforcement_layers.check_constraints: chk_geometry_status_classification_consistency prevents setting status='OFFICIAL' with unverified or scenario classifications.

trigger_function.name: fn_guard_geometry_official_promotion
trigger_function.events: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, authority_classification, dataset_version_id, provenance_id
assertions: evidence_records.verification_authority IS NOT NULL AND evidence_records.verified_by IS NOT NULL
Target W014 version belongs to an active legal regime (delimitation_regimes.legal_status = 'CURRENT_LEGAL_REGIME')

enforcement_layers.rls: Only service_role can execute INSERT/UPDATE on public.entity_geometries.
enforcement_layers.ingestion_service: Pre-flight validation of SHA-256 checksum and geometry winding prior to SQL submission.

current_semantics_and_invariants.is_current_modeling: Independently stored BOOLEAN, strictly constrained by database check constraint chk_geometry_current_invariants. Physically impossible for candidates or scenarios to have is_current = true.

authoritative_replacement_lifecycle.principle: Spatial comparison is evidence only. Spatial similarity/difference MUST NOT automatically confer authority.
lifecycle_stages: 1. CANDIDATE_ACQUISITION: Candidate geometry acquired and quarantined as UNVERIFIED / is_current = false.
2. CERTIFIED_SOURCE_ACQUISITION: Certified constitutional/statutory boundary artifact obtained.
3. COEXISTENCE: Certified geometry ingested as a distinct dataset_version without touching candidate rows.
4. SPATIAL_AUDIT: Automated spatial comparison (ST_Difference, Hausdorff distance) run as observational evidence.
5. EVIDENCE_REVIEW: Independent CTO / Legal audit verifies statutory Gazette / Delimitation Order lineage.
6. AUTHORIZED_PROMOTION: Explicit governance decision elevates certified row to status='OFFICIAL' and is_current=true.
7. OFFICIAL_CURRENT_GEOMETRY: Row becomes active and publicly visible via RLS.

performance_evaluation.status: PERFORMANCE STATUS = UNKNOWN UNTIL IMPLEMENTED AND BENCHMARKED

categories: 2. Bounding-box spatial filter (&& operator against viewport bbox)
3. Current official geometry lookup (Indexed is_current = true filter)
5. Historical geometry query (temporal window filter valid_from <= d AND valid_to > d)
7. Representative map viewport query (MVT / BBOX intersection)
future_benchmark_plan.methodology: Execution of EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on staging PostGIS with cold and warm cache after authorized implementation.

safe_rollback_architecture.prohibition_of_destructive_w012_cascade: W012 data_sources, datasets, dataset_versions, and provenance_records are permanent governance assets. Destructive CASCADE or DELETE against W012 records is strictly prohibited.
safe_rollback_scope: 2. Drop trigger and trigger function (trg_guard_geometry_official_promotion, fn_guard_geometry_official_promotion)
3. Drop table public.entity_geometries (drops all spatial indexes)
4. Dependency Check: Query record_provenance_linkages and evidence_records to verify if W012 dataset versions are referenced elsewhere.
5. If unreferenced and isolated, mark dataset_versions as is_active = false or delete; if referenced, preserve untouched.
safe_rollback_architecture.irreversible_state_acknowledgment: Once geometry records or provenance linkages have been referenced in verified audit logs or external domain entities, an in-place destructive rollback of W012 governance entities is impossible and governance history must be preserved.

mandal_historical_safety.database_enforcement: chk_mandal_historical_only requires temporal_classification = 'HISTORICAL_LEGAL', is_current = false, valid_to = '2022-09-01'.
mandal_historical_safety.current_attachment_prevented: Cannot attach to current mandal entities; chk_geometry_current_invariants physically forbids is_current = true.
mandal_historical_safety.missing_23_mandals: Remain UNKNOWN / BLOCKED (UNK-16-01). Inferred spatial aggregation is NOT encoded into statutory relationship tables.

observational_taxonomy: CONFIRM: Spatial intersection supports statutory containment.
CONTRADICT: Spatial intersection deviates from statutory containment; statutory containment prevails.
INCONCLUSIVE: Border slivers or digitisation imprecision; statutory containment prevails.
UNAVAILABLE: Geometry absent; statutory relationship functions uninterrupted.
w015_relational_primacy.automatic_rewrite_prohibited: Geometry computations NEVER automatically update relational tables.

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: Explicit FK columns constituency_version_id, district_version_id, state_version_id, pc_version_id with ON DELETE RESTRICT
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: INSERT geometry with non-existent UUID fails with foreign key violation 23503
INSERT geometry with all NULLs or multiple non-NULL FKs fails with check constraint violation 23514

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: RLS SELECT policy on entity_geometries restricted to status = 'OFFICIAL' AND is_current = true
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: Querying entity_geometries under anon role returns 0 rows for UNVERIFIED candidate rows
Querying entity_geometries under anon role returns 0 rows for SCENARIO rows

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: Trigger fn_guard_geometry_official_promotion validates evidence_records and statutory source authority
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: UPDATE status = 'OFFICIAL' on candidate row without evidence record raises exception 23514

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: Partial unique indexes on (constituency_version_id) and (district_version_id) WHERE is_current = true
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: Setting is_current = true on two geometries for the same version fails with unique violation 23505

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: CHECK (is_current = false) whenever temporal_classification = 'HISTORICAL_LEGAL' and valid_to <= CURRENT_DATE
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: Setting is_current = true on a historical geometry violates chk_geometry_current_invariants

acceptance_matrix.requirement: 589 Mandals Cannot Attach to Current Versions
acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: CHECK chk_mandal_historical_only enforces temporal_classification = 'HISTORICAL_LEGAL' and is_current = false
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: INSERT mandal geometry with is_current = true fails with check violation 23514

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: Multiple rows permitted for same entity with different dataset_version_id when is_current = false
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: Simultaneous presence of TGRAC candidate row and official ECI row for same AC verifies successfully

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: NOT NULL FKs to dataset_versions(id) and provenance_records(id) with SHA-256 checksum column
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: Geometry row directly resolves to source publisher and raw artifact SHA-256 via relational JOIN

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: Zero database triggers connecting geometry to mandal_constituency_map; relationship tables remain decoupled
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: Geometry ingestion leaves mandal_constituency_map rows and booth counts 100% unchanged

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: Rollback DDL drops spatial tables/views only; W012 catalog records preserved with dependency validation
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: Rollback script executed on staging leaves data_sources, datasets, and provenance_records intact

acceptance_matrix.design_mechanism: All speculative performance claims removed; comprehensive 7-category benchmark plan defined
acceptance_matrix.runtime_verification_test: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) benchmarks executed post-implementation on staging
